source_of_truth.provider: ChatGPT Library (image binaries) + Dropbox Paper (curated index)
source_of_truth.library_access: ChatGPT Library files are the primary visual source; Dropbox Paper is the curated index. The local engine cannot query either source directly, so exact exports must be staged with provenance and checksum verification.
source_of_truth.policy: Preserve original library assets. Stage explicit local exports as separate copies; never modify, move, or overwrite originals.

usage_policy.rights_status: unverified; confirm source rights before public or commercial distribution
usage_policy.model_generated_field: Preserve the Library's generated/source classification; false does not prove authorship, ownership, or license.
usage_policy.transformation: Every derived render must link to source asset IDs and remain separate from the source files.

assets.visual_notes: Close seated-car crop. Very large rounded paired pectoral masses, strong central cleft, visible chest-hair texture, arm crossing the lower torso. Establishes the primary chest shape and projection target.

Same seated-car setup, face, beard, arm placement, and crop. The chest reads marginally fuller and more rounded than the base, especially through the upper and lateral contour; treat this as a subtle visual difference, not a measured growth stage.

Same composition and subject design. The paired pec masses appear more spherical and forward-projecting, with a pronounced medial cleft and lower contour; the viewer-right pec is especially full. Camera perspective and close crop exaggerate apparent depth.

Full-body adult male bodybuilder in a domestic doorway/bedroom setting, with bare feet, visible floor, doorway and bed edge. Strong paired pectoral lobes, very broad deltoids/arms, defined abdomen and large legs. Best for figure-to-room scale and full-length silhouette; identity continuity with the car subject is unconfirmed.
Closely related front-facing full-body bedroom composition with similar body design and room cues. Useful as a second scale/framing comparison, not as proof of the car subject's identity.

Tighter crop from head through thighs. Emphasizes large pectoral lobes, chest-to-deltoid transition, abdominal surface, skin texture and distressed denim fit. Use for surface and garment behavior; do not transfer the reference face or identity.

Low-resolution seated-car image with a similar crop and subject presentation. Its relationship to the generated car sequence is not established by the canonical manifest; preserve as a separate source candidate and do not infer identity or generation lineage.

library_export_verification.method: Exact raw files materialized from ChatGPT Library; SHA-256, byte size and pixel dimensions measured without image modification.
library_export_verification.note: These checksums identify the selected Library bytes. They do not establish copyright ownership or authorize external transfer.
